name: Speed Lab
tagline: Runs a research loop on your site's render speed and keeps the wins
description: Works through a ranked list of around fifty front-end performance techniques, applies each one, measures whether it actually helped, and keeps only the changes that did. It can grind through the list itself or hand the work to a cloud agent while you watch.

source.excerpt: Shared as an autoresearch loop that makes a site measurably faster over time.

body:
## What it does

Works through a ranked list of around fifty front-end performance techniques, applies each one, measures whether it actually helped, and keeps only the changes that did. It can grind through the list itself or hand the work to a cloud agent while you watch. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @pwnies shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
